{"parentUuid":"5a49da18-bca7-469c-a374-5858ff6681f2","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"mcp_instructions_delta","addedNames":["plugin:context7:context7","plugin:serena:serena"],"addedBlocks":["## plugin:context7:context7\nUse this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. {"parentUuid":"bc85265d-91b2-4056-a56b-3295925fde40","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- empirical-probe-first: Probe ALL viable strategies in a multi-option ladder BEFORE committing to one. Use when a session-plan / decision-ADR / spec presents ≥3 strategy options (e.g. \"Strategy A1/A2/A3\" or \"alternative B/C/D\") and the recommended option's source-evidence may be stale. Outputs a probe matrix per strategy + commit decision with empirical citation. Pairs with `vendor-api-probe.sh` (deterministic detection layer; SessionStart hook) and `decompose-work` (deterministic-vs-LLM split per probe). Charter promotion target — codifies L-S32-1 doctrine surfaced at S32 Track A pivot (master-plan recommended A2 vnstock alternate; empirical probe rejected A1+A2; A3 SSI direct httpx adopted instead).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- hook-diagnostics: Inspect hook event lifecycle (state machine + transcript cache + aggregator output) when triaging failed/stuck hooks or auditing self-awareness rollups. Use during sandwich-verifier review, drift investigation, or post-mortem when component-telemetry.jsonl + dispatch.jsonl + sessions-rollup.tsv need cross-checking.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- session-memory-l0-l1: Extract structured memories (L0 quick metadata + L1 deep) from a Claude Code session JSONL transcript. L0 is pure regex (file paths, commands, errors, failures incl. Vietnamese phrases, next step). L1 ships the prompt builder + response parser + 15+35 head/tail windowing — caller dispatches the LLM (no auto-invoke in Phase 0). Plus cleanText harness-stripper + TranscriptCache (mtime+size dual-check + LRU). Use when ingesting a session for memory promotion, computing what files/commands/failures the session touched, or preparing an offline LLM extraction.\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- sync-pull: On-demand confidence-score lookup before a SCOPE+/ARCH/IMPL decision. Reads agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv + weights.yaml; surfaces the relevant category's score, tier, must-grill flag, and the decision-class threshold. Output drives \"self-decide vs grill\" choice. Use whenever an agent is about to commit a non-trivial decision and needs to ground confidence in historical hit rate per Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence).\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Use when extracting a pattern from multiple sessions into a reusable skill, or when user asks to formalize a technique. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- ccs:continue: Continue last CCS delegation session [AUTO ENHANCE]\n- ccs: Delegate task with intelligent profile selection [AUTO ENHANCE]\n- autonomous: /autonomous — Toggle Autonomous Mode (on/off/status)\n- budget-check: /budget-check — Current Session Token Budget Status\n- devils-advocate: /devils-advocate — Adversarial Critique\n- drift-check: /drift-check — Run Drift Signals DR1-DR12\n- drill-me: /drill-me — Interactive Ubiquitous Language Extraction\n- grill-me: /grill-me — Relentless Plan/Design Interview\n- handoff-read: /handoff-read — Lightweight Last Session Load\n- master-plan: /master-plan — High-Level Work Decomposition\n- session-end: /session-end — Close Work Session\n- session-start: /session-start — Begin Work Session\n- session-verify: /session-verify — Mid-Session Alignment Check\n- spec-author: /spec-author — Create Dual-Layer Specification\n- spec-to-wiki: /spec-to-wiki — Convert Raw Spec to Obsidian Wiki Format\n- ul-audit: /ul-audit — Audit Ubiquitous Language Consistency\n- vbw-check: /vbw-check — Apply Verify-Before-Write Protocol\n- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation\n- review: Review a pull request\n- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch","skillCount":51,"isInitial":true},"type":"attachment","uuid":"871e3fd1-cd69-43ed-b427-690077060ceb","timestamp":"2026-05-14T07:31:29.725Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"0feebcd1-f1e5-45b7-b72e-a3e4389b0ef7","version":"2.1.138","gitBranch":"main"}

Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\r\n\r\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\r\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\r\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\r\n\r\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Subdirectories\r\n\r\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\r\n|---|---|---|\r\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\r\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\r\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\r\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\r\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\r\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\r\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\r\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\r\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\r\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\r\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\r\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Read-only for IMPL sessions. | Append + revisited per calibration |\r\n| `memory/sync-tracker/` | Track 8a output: Confidence Score SQLite + weights.yaml + auto-rendered `_index.md`. | Live updated by hooks |\r\n| `memory/self-awareness/` | Track 9 output: model × effort × thinking profile cards + known-issues + best-practices. | Live updated by Stop-hook aggregator |\r\n| `memory/mistake-log.md` | Track 7 deliverable: structured failure catalog. What went wrong / Root cause / Prevention rule / Severity. | Append; pre-flight read by all agents |\r\n| `session-plans/pending/` | Plans authored, awaiting execution. Phase 0 plan lives here. | Move to `completed/` when done |\r\n| `session-plans/completed/` | Executed plans; archived for reference + retrospective input. | Append |\r\n| `quality-reports/{deterministic,probabilistic,drift-reports}/` | Tier-1/2/3 gate outputs (CLAUDE.md § Quality Gates). | Per-run files |\r\n| `ubiquitous-language/` | DDD glossary + domain-mapping + drift-log. Stockforge stock-domain vocabulary. | Append; canonical via `/drill-me` |\r\n| `calibration/` | Empirical hit-rate data per signal type. Confidence claims MUST trace here (CLAUDE.md hard rule). | Append per thesis post-mortem |\r\n| `research/` | Research notes from `research-scanner` subagent dispatches (e.g., reference-repo studies). | Append |\r\n\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\r\n\r\n1. **Constitution is immutable absent explicit human approval.** `Edit/Write` to `agent-workspace/constitution/**` is in `.claude/settings.json` deny list. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\r\n\r\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\r\n\r\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\r\n\r\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\r\n\r\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). Every confidence claim cites historical hit rate (I-S20-equivalent).\r\n\r\n6. **Agents never `git commit` in this directory unless user explicitly requests.** Stage only.\r\n\r\n7. **`patterns-discovered/` artifacts are READ-ONLY for production code.** Patterns must be promoted to constitution / skills / hook scripts before becoming binding. Scans across artifact types\n# and emits `agent-workspace/memory/.severity-state.tsv` with normalized severity rows.\n#\n# Severity schema (per agent-workspace/constitution/severity-schema.md):\n#   CRITICAL — block autonomous mode immediately\n#   HIGH     — escalate to AskUserQuestion at 6h pending\n#   MEDIUM   — digest after 168h\n#   LOW      — log only\n#\n# Bash + POSIX only per L-S11-1. Best-effort: never fails Stop chain on its own errors (RC=0).\n\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nMEM_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nSTATE_FILE=\"$MEM_DIR/.severity-state.tsv\"\nLOG=\"$MEM_DIR/.severity-classifier.log\"\nQA_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/human-workspace/q-and-a/pending\"\nDECISIONS_DIR=\"$MEM_DIR/decisions\"\nMISTAKE_LOG=\"$MEM_DIR/mistake-log.md\"\nURGENT=\"$PROJECT_DIR/human-workspace/notifications/urgent.md\"\n\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds)\"\nNOW_EPOCH=\"$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\"\n\nmkdir -p \"$MEM_DIR\" \"$(dirname \"$LOG\")\"\n\n# Atomic state-file rewrite: write to temp + rename (NEVER append; classifier is full re-scan).\nTMP=\"$STATE_FILE.tmp.$$\"\n\n# Header\n{\n  printf '# severity-state.tsv — generated %s by severity-classifier.sh\\n' \"$TS\"\n  printf '# columns: severity\\\\tartifact_path\\\\tage_hours\\\\tnext_action\\\\tclassified_at\\n'\n  printf '# severity: CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW\\n'\n  printf '# next_action: BLOCK | ESCALATE-ASKUSERQUESTION | DIGEST | LOG-ONLY\\n'\n} > \"$TMP\"\n\n# Helper: age in hours from file mtime\nage_hours() {\n  local f=\"$1\"\n  local mt\n  mt=$(stat -c %Y \"$f\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\n  echo $(( (NOW_EPOCH - mt) / 3600 ))\n}\n\nemit_row() {\n  local sev=\"$1\" path=\"$2\" age=\"$3\" action=\"$4\"\n  printf '%s\\t%s\\t%s\\t%s\\t%s\\n' \"$sev\" \"$path\" \"$age\" \"$action\" \"$TS\" >> \"$TMP\"\n}\n\n# === Layer 1: CRITICAL — stale-checkpoint marker, charter violation markers ===\n# NOTE: .autonomous-BLOCKED is deliberately NOT in this list. It is escalation\n# OUTPUT (written by escalation-engine.sh when CRITICAL rows exist), not input.\n# Including it created a self-perpetuating deadlock: flag present -> CRITICAL row\n# -> escalation-engine re-writes flag -> never clears. Mirrors the urgent.md\n# self-loop guard in Layer 5.\nCRIT_MARKERS=(\n  \"$MEM_DIR/.auto-reboot-PRE-BLOCKED-stale-checkpoint\"\n  \"$MEM_DIR/.charter-violation-detected\"\n  \"$MEM_DIR/.ghost-greening-confirmed\"\n)\nfor m in \"${CRIT_MARKERS[@]}\"; do\n  [ -f \"$m\" ] || continue\n  rel=\"${m#$PROJECT_DIR/}\"\n  age=$(age_hours \"$m\")\n  emit_row \"CRITICAL\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"BLOCK\"\ndone\n\n# === Layer 2: Q&A pending bundles → HIGH at 6h pending, CRITICAL at 96h ===\nif [ -d \"$QA_DIR\" ]; then\n  while IFS= read -r f; do\n    [ -z \"$f\" ] && continue\n    [ -f \"$f\" ] || continue\n    # Skip if status is answered/closed/resolved (per HH-E.2 auto-mv rule)\n    status_line=$(head -20 \"$f\" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 '^status:' || true)\n    case \"$status_line\" in\n      *answered-*|*closed-*|*resolved-*) continue ;;\n    esac\n    rel=\"${f#$PROJECT_DIR/}\"\n    age=$(age_hours \"$f\")\n    if [ \"$age\" -ge 96 ]; then\n      emit_row \"CRITICAL\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"BLOCK\"\n    elif [ \"$age\" -ge 6 ]; then\n      emit_row \"HIGH\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"ESCALATE-ASKUSERQUESTION\"\n    else\n      emit_row \"LOW\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"LOG-ONLY\"\n    fi\n  done < <(find \"$QA_DIR\" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name \"*.md\" 2>/dev/null | sort)\nfi\n\n# === Layer 3: Decisions PROPOSED with expired cool-down → HIGH (if charter-tier) / MEDIUM (other) ===\nif [ -d \"$DECISIONS_DIR\" ]; then\n  while IFS= read -r d; do\n    [ -z \"$d\" ] && continue\n    [ -f \"$d\" ] || continue\n    # Skip templates / README / index files (NOT real decisions)\n    base=$(basename \"$d\")\n    case \"$base\" in\n      _template.md|README.md|TEMPLATE.md|index.md) continue ;;\n    esac\n    status_line=$(head -30 \"$d\" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 '^status:' || true)\n    case \"$status_line\" in\n      *PROPOSED*) ;;\n      *) continue ;;\n    esac\n    level_line=$(head -30 \"$d\" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 '^level:' || true)\n    rel=\"${d#$PROJECT_DIR/}\"\n    age=$(age_hours \"$d\")\n    # Cool-down: charter-tier 24h, scope/arch 12h, impl 0h\n    case \"$level_line\" in\n      *CHARTER*)\n        cd_h=24\n        sev_if_expired=\"HIGH\"\n        ;;\n      *SCOPE*|*ARCH*)\n        cd_h=12\n        sev_if_expired=\"MEDIUM\"\n        ;;\n      *)\n        cd_h=0\n        sev_if_expired=\"LOW\"\n        ;;\n    esac\n    if [ \"$age\" -ge \"$cd_h\" ]; then\n      action=\"ESCALATE-ASKUSERQUESTION\"\n      [ \"$sev_if_expired\" = \"MEDIUM\" ] && action=\"DIGEST\"\n      [ \"$sev_if_expired\" = \"LOW\" ] && action=\"LOG-ONLY\"\n      emit_row \"$sev_if_expired\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"$action\"\n    fi\n  done < <(find \"$DECISIONS_DIR\" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name \"*.md\" 2>/dev/null | sort)\nfi\n\n# === Layer 4: Mistake log severity scan (last 30 lines for recent unresolved) ===\n# Filter logic: emit only when there's an unresolved NEW high/critical mistake.\n# Exclude \"resolved\", \"carryover\" (knowingly tracked-not-stale), \"SHIPPED\" (fix landed).\nif [ -f \"$MISTAKE_LOG\" ]; then\n  # pipefail + while-read-EOF returns RC=1; wrap in subshell with || true to prevent trap ERR exit\n  ( tail -50 \"$MISTAKE_LOG\" 2>/dev/null \\\n    | grep -E \"Severity (critical|high)\" 2>/dev/null \\\n    | grep -v -E \"resolved|carryover|SHIPPED|FIX-SHIPPED|RETRO-DISCOVERED\" 2>/dev/null \\\n    | head -5 \\\n    | while IFS= read -r line; do\n        case \"$line\" in\n          *critical*) emit_row \"CRITICAL\" \"agent-workspace/memory/mistake-log.md\" \"0\" \"BLOCK\" ;;\n          *high*)     emit_row \"HIGH\"     \"agent-workspace/memory/mistake-log.md\" \"0\" \"ESCALATE-ASKUSERQUESTION\" ;;\n        esac\n      done\n  ) || true\nfi\n\n# === Layer 5: Notifications severity scan (last 24h via mtime) ===\n# Classification is driven by the frontmatter `level:` field — the authoritative\n# self-declared severity (notifications are named N-<TS>-<level>-<slug>.md per\n# human-workspace/CLAUDE.md). Body-text keyword grep is FALLBACK ONLY, for legacy\n# notifications with no `level:` field.\n# Why: the old body-grep-first logic mis-escalated any notification that merely\n# MENTIONED the word \"critical\" (e.g. an ALERT file *describing* a critical\n# finding) to CRITICAL severity → false autonomous-mode block.\nif [ -d \"$PROJECT_DIR/human-workspace/notifications\" ]; then\n  while IFS= read -r n; do\n    [ -z \"$n\" ] && continue\n    [ -f \"$n\" ] || continue\n    # Skip urgent.md + digest files (these are escalation OUTPUTS, not inputs — avoid self-loop)\n    base=$(basename \"$n\")\n    case \"$base\" in\n      urgent.md|urgent-archived-*.md|digest-*.md) continue ;;\n    esac\n    # Skip notifications already resolved/answered/deferred (frontmatter status)\n    nstatus=$(head -10 \"$n\" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 '^status:' || true)\n    case \"$nstatus\" in\n      *ANSWERED*|*RESOLVED*|*DEFERRED*|*answered-*|*resolved-*|*deferred-*) continue ;;\n    esac\n    rel=\"${n#$PROJECT_DIR/}\"\n    age=$(age_hours \"$n\")\n    [ \"$age\" -le 24 ] || continue\n    # Authoritative: frontmatter `level:` field (strip whitespace incl. CR for CRLF files).\n    nlevel=$(head -10 \"$n\" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 '^level:' | sed 's/^level:[[:space:]]*//' | tr -d '[:space:]' || true)\n    case \"$nlevel\" in\n      CRITICAL|critical|Critical)\n        emit_row \"CRITICAL\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"BLOCK\" ;;\n      ALERT|alert|Alert|URGENT|urgent|Urgent)\n        emit_row \"HIGH\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"ESCALATE-ASKUSERQUESTION\" ;;\n      WARN|warn|Warn|WARNING|warning|Warning)\n        emit_row \"MEDIUM\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"DIGEST\" ;;\n      INFO|info|Info|SUMMARY|summary|Summary)\n        emit_row \"LOW\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"LOG-ONLY\" ;;\n      *)\n        # No recognized `level:` frontmatter — fall back to body keyword scan (legacy).\n        if grep -q \"CRITICAL\\|critical\" \"$n\" 2>/dev/null; then\n          emit_row \"CRITICAL\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"BLOCK\"\n        elif grep -q \"ALERT\\|alert\\|URGENT\" \"$n\" 2>/dev/null; then\n          emit_row \"HIGH\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"ESCALATE-ASKUSERQUESTION\"\n        elif grep -q \"WARN\\|warn\" \"$n\" 2>/dev/null; then\n          emit_row \"MEDIUM\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"DIGEST\"\n        else\n          emit_row \"LOW\" \"$rel\" \"$age\" \"LOG-ONLY\"\n        fi\n        ;;\n    esac\n  done < <(find \"$PROJECT_DIR/human-workspace/notifications\" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name \"*.md\" 2>/dev/null | sort)\nfi\n\n# Atomic install\nmv -f \"$TMP\" \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f \"$TMP\"; exit 0; }\n\n# Summary log\nCRIT_N=$(grep \"^CRITICAL\" \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' \\n')\nHIGH_N=$(grep \"^HIGH\" \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' \\n')\nMED_N=$(grep \"^MEDIUM\" \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' \\n')\nLOW_N=$(grep \"^LOW\" \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' \\n')\n[ -z \"$CRIT_N\" ] && CRIT_N=0\n[ -z \"$HIGH_N\" ] && HIGH_N=0\n[ -z \"$MED_N\" ] && MED_N=0\n[ -z \"$LOW_N\" ] && LOW_N=0\nprintf '[%s] severity-classifier: CRITICAL=%s HIGH=%s MEDIUM=%s LOW=%s\\n' \"$TS\" \"$CRIT_N\" \"$HIGH_N\" \"$MED_N\" \"$LOW_N\" >> \"$LOG\"\n\n# Stderr alert if CRITICAL or HIGH\nif [ \"$CRIT_N\" -gt 0 ] || [ \"$HIGH_N\" -gt 0 ]; (Optional) Set STOCKFORGE_TELEGRAM_DRY_RUN=1 to log without HTTP call\n#\n# Without credentials → exits silently (no-op).\n# Best-effort: never fails caller on network/API error.\n#\n# Args: $1 severity (CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW), $2 message body\n# Idempotency: per-event marker via SHA of (severity + first 80 chars of message + hour-bucket).\n#\n# Bash + POSIX only per L-S11-1.\n\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nSEVERITY=\"${1:-LOW}\"\nMESSAGE=\"${2:-(no message)}\"\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nMEM_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nLOG=\"$MEM_DIR/.telegram-push.log\"\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds)\"\n\nmkdir -p \"$MEM_DIR\"\n\nTOKEN=\"${STOCKFORGE_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN:-}\"\nCHAT_ID=\"${STOCKFORGE_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID:-}\"\nDRY_RUN=\"${STOCKFORGE_TELEGRAM_DRY_RUN:-0}\"\n\n# No credentials → silent no-op (skeleton mode awaiting user config)\nif [ -z \"$TOKEN\" ] || [ -z \"$CHAT_ID\" ]; then\n  printf '[%s] telegram-push: SKIPPED (creds not configured) severity=%s\\n' \"$TS\" \"$SEVERITY\" >> \"$LOG\"\n  exit 0\nfi\n\n# Idempotency: hash-based marker\nHASH=$(printf '%s|%s|%s' \"$SEVERITY\" \"${MESSAGE:0:80}\" \"$(date +%Y%m%d-%H 2>/dev/null)\" | md5sum 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1 || echo \"nohash\")\nMARKER=\"$MEM_DIR/.telegram-pushed-${HASH}\"\n\n# Cleanup stale markers (older than 24h)\nfind \"$MEM_DIR\" -maxdepth 1 -name \".telegram-pushed-*\" -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true\n\n[ -f \"$MARKER\" ] && exit 0\n\n# Severity prefix (ASCII-only for cross-platform UTF-8 reliability)\n# Note: emoji were attempted but Windows bash + curl --data-urlencode mishandles UTF-8 multibyte\n# resulting in Telegram API 400 \"strings must be encoded in UTF-8\". {"parentUuid":"814bd250-7c0d-49af-9c46-d8a0f868ed54","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"8446c19e-f3ac-4348-b876-05eb970e6038","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01WkGJPzZJcWeQ8wek8mJH25","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# /autonomous — Toggle Autonomous Mode (on/off/status)\n2\t\n3\t> Created 2026-05-05 (S48 post-incident) per user request: \"biến setting autonomous thành một dạng skill/command hay cấu hình nào để để human dễ dàng turn on/off thông qua prompt\".\n4\t> Atomic toggle of TWO settings + stale marker cleanup. Single command for end-user.\n5\t\n6\t## Usage\n7\t\n8\t| Form | Effect |\n9\t|---|---|\n10\t| `/autonomous on` | Enable full-autonomous (continue-injector + budget-watchdog active) |\n11\t| `/autonomous off` | Disable autonomous (no auto-/clear+continue, no auto-reboot) |\n12\t| `/autonomous status` | Report current state (default if no arg) |\n13\t| `/autonomous` | Same as `/autonomous status` |\n14\t\n15\t## What it changes (atomically)\n16\t\n17\tTwo settings must flip together — flipping only one leaves harness in inconsistent state (audit § DRC-3 + S48 incident root cause):\n18\t\n19\t1. **`agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md`** — field `**autonomous_mode**` (`true` / `false`)\n20\t   - Gates: `autonomous-stop-watchdog.sh:22` (Mode A/B/C/D detection); `session-start-bootstrap.sh:135` (continue-injector for `source=startup` only); 4+ other Stop/PostToolUse hook downstream consumers.\n21\t2. **`.claude/settings.json`** — env `STOCKFORGE_WATCHDOG_DISABLE` (`\"1\"` / `\"0\"`)\n22\t   - Gates: `budget-watchdog.sh:21` early-exit (auto-reboot at wind-down/cliff thresholds 180K/220K).\n23\t\n24\tWhen turning ON, **also clear stale once-only markers** (otherwise watchdog won't refire):\n25\t- `agent-workspace/memory/.cliff-fired`\n26\t- `agent-workspace/memory/.wind-down`\n27\t- `agent-workspace/memory/.wind-down-fired`\n28\t- `agent-workspace/memory/.mode-{a,b,c,d}-recovery-fired-*`\n29\t- `agent-workspace/memory/.auto-reboot-FAILED`\n30\t\n31\t## Agent execution instructions\n32\t\n33\t### When user invokes `/autonomous on`\n34\t\n35\t1. **Edit `agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md`**:\n36\t   - Find line starting `**autonomous_mode**:` (search by exact prefix; Agent decides action.\n# Wired as UserPromptSubmit in .claude/settings.local.json (after invariants-injector).\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nINTAKE_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/up-intake-log.md\"\nDECISIONS_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/decisions\"\nEXEC_FILE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\nHOOK_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\n\nmkdir -p \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\n\nPAYLOAD=\"$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)\"\nUSER_PROMPT=\"$(printf '%s' \"$PAYLOAD\" | node -e \"\nlet s=''; process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);\nprocess.stdin.on('end',()=>{ try { console.log(JSON.parse(s).prompt || JSON.parse(s).user_message || ''); } catch { console.log(''); } });\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"\")\"\n\n# Skip on empty / trivial prompts.\nif [ -z \"$USER_PROMPT\" ]; then exit 0; fi\nif printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | head -c 40 | grep -qiE '^[[:space:]]*(continue|ok|yes|y|n|no|done)[[:space:]]*$'; then\n  exit 0\nfi\n\nWARNINGS=\"\"\n\nadd_warning() {\n  if [ -z \"$WARNINGS\" ]; then\n    WARNINGS=\"$1\"\n  else\n    WARNINGS=\"$WARNINGS\n$1\"\n  fi\n}\n\n# === UP-NN reference check ===\nif [ -f \"$INTAKE_LOG\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE 'UP-[0-9]+' | sort -u || true); do\n    STATUS=$(awk -v ref=\"$ref\" '\n      $0 ~ \"up_id: \" ref \"$\" { in_entry=1; next }\n      in_entry && /^- up_id:/ { in_entry=0 }\n      in_entry && /^[[:space:]]*status:/ { gsub(/^[[:space:]]*status:[[:space:]]*/,\"\"); print; exit }\n    ' \"$INTAKE_LOG\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n    if [ -n \"$STATUS\" ] && printf '%s' \"$STATUS\" | grep -qE '^closed-'; then\n      add_warning \"- $ref is CLOSED ($STATUS per up-intake-log.md). If user wants to revisit, treat as new scope; otherwise surface closure status (cite the linked decision) before re-doing work.\"\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === D-NNN reference check ===\nif [ -d \"$DECISIONS_DIR\" ]; then\n  for ref in $(printf '%s' \"$USER_PROMPT\" | grep -oE 'D-[0-9]+' | sort -u || true); do\n    NUM=$(printf '%s' \"$ref\" | sed 's/D-0*//; s/^$/0/')\n    NUM_PADDED=$(printf '%03d' \"$NUM\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"$NUM\")\n    DEC_FILE=$(ls \"$DECISIONS_DIR\"/${NUM_PADDED}-*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n    if [ -n \"$DEC_FILE\" ]; then\n      DEC_STATUS=$(awk '/^status:/ { gsub(/^status:[[:space:]]*/,\"\"); print; exit }' \"$DEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n      if printf '%s' \"$DEC_STATUS\" | grep -qiE '^(ACCEPTED|SUPERSEDED|REJECTED)$'; then\n        add_warning \"- $ref already in terminal status ($DEC_STATUS per $DEC_FILE). Re-opening requires explicit user pick + new ADR (D-NNN+1 superseding) — do not silently re-decide.\"\n      fi\n    fi\n  done\nfi\n\n# === Track N(.Nx) reference check ===\n# NOTE on L-S53-2 lint advice (S56 categorization, KI-S55-1 family):\n#   bash-hook-lint Check 8 flags `grep -oE 'Track [0-9]+...'` here as unanchored\n#   positional-marker → suggests `^` anchor. WRONG advice: target is `$USER_PROMPT`\n#   piped variable holding free-form user input where \"Track 5\" can appear anywhere.\n#   Anchoring `^Track [0-9]+` would only match prompts STARTING with \"Track <N>\"\n#   (e.g. user types \"remind me about Track 5\" → mid-prompt → anchored grep\n#   misses). Use while-read with IFS= to preserve the full match.\n#   Sibling UP-NN + D-NNN + S<N> loops below are safe because matched tokens\n#   have no internal whitespace (hyphenated or single word).\nif [ -f \"$EXEC_FILE\" ]; then\n  while IFS= read -r ref; do\n    [ -z \"$ref\" ] && continue\n    TRACK_NUM=$(printf '%s' \"$ref\" | sed 's/^Track //')\n    DONE_LINE=$(grep -E \"Track ${TRACK_NUM}.*(✅|DONE|done)\" \"$EXEC_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)\n    if [ -n \"$DONE_LINE\" ]; then\n      add_warning \"- $ref is marked DONE in current-execution.md. {"parentUuid":"467bb69c-2dde-4d23-97bc-6fa4f96311b3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01Cgd4GJn6sDz24FrKQyg4VZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HoydG3N4NHswUjmTzbjYtd","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\scripts\\hooks\\block-control.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# block-control.sh — unified human-gate (block / unblock) control for StockForge.\n#\n# THE single interface for the \"agent hits a block / q&a / confirm / decision that\n# needs a human -> notify -> human approves -> resume\" loop. Replaces the scattered,\n# deadlock-prone manual flag management (the S316/2026-05-14 incident: clearing a\n# block required a human to manually `rm` 3 files because Write/Bash were themselves\n# blocked).\n#\n# Subcommands:\n#   raise <severity> <slug> -- <reason / recommendation text...>\n#       Agent calls this when it hits something needing a human. Writes the\n#       .autonomous-BLOCKED flag (structured: severity + slug + reason + resume steps)\n#       and sends a Telegram push. Idempotent: will NOT overwrite an existing gate.\n#\n#   clear [actor] [reason...]\n#       Clears the gate. Removes .autonomous-BLOCKED + the stale .severity-state.tsv\n#       cache (escalation-engine reads it on UserPromptSubmit and would instantly\n#       re-raise) + false-positive .auto-reboot-PRE-BLOCKED-* markers. Writes\n#       .block-grace (default 30 min) so escalation-engine won't instantly re-raise,\n#       giving the agent room to fix the root cause. This is the anti-deadlock path.\n#\n#   status\n#       Prints BLOCKED (+ flag content) or CLEAR (+ grace remaining). RC=0 always.\n#\n#   check-prompt\n#       UserPromptSubmit hook entry. Reads the user prompt from stdin JSON; if a gate\n#       is active AND the prompt contains an approval keyword (approved / unblock /\n#       run autonomous / go ahead / proceed / tiep tuc / dong y ...) with no negation,\n#       auto-runs `clear`. Emits a stdout confirmation (becomes additionalContext).\n#       This is what lets a human resume by just replying \"approved\" — no file ops.\n#\n# Bash + POSIX only per L-S11-1 (node is allowed — Claude Code runtime; used only to\n# parse stdin JSON in check-prompt, mirroring stale-prompt-detector.sh +\n# correction-rate-tracker.sh).\n# Best-effort: RC=0 always; never fails a hook chain.\n# SPAWN-CONTEXT: positional-arg (subcommand is $1; companion firing-test required per L-S247-1)\n\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nMEM_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nBLOCK_FLAG=\"$MEM_DIR/.autonomous-BLOCKED\"\nSTATE_FILE=\"$MEM_DIR/.severity-state.tsv\"\nGRACE_FILE=\"$MEM_DIR/.block-grace\"\nLOG=\"$MEM_DIR/.block-control.log\"\nTELEGRAM_HOOK=\"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/telegram-push.sh\"\n\nGRACE_SECONDS=\"${STOCKFORGE_BLOCK_GRACE_SECONDS:-1800}\"\ncase \"$GRACE_SECONDS\" in ''|*[!0-9]*) GRACE_SECONDS=1800 ;; esac\n\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)\"\nNOW_EPOCH=\"$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\"\ncase \"$NOW_EPOCH\" in ''|*[!0-9]*) NOW_EPOCH=0 ;; esac\n\nmkdir -p \"$MEM_DIR\"\n\nSUBCMD=\"${1:-status}\"\n\nlog() { printf '[%s] block-control %s: %s\\n' \"$TS\" \"$SUBCMD\" \"$1\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>/dev/null || true; }\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# raise <severity> <slug> -- <reason...>\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncmd_raise() {\n  local severity slug reason\n  severity=\"${1:-HIGH}\"\n  slug=\"${2:-unspecified}\"\n  reason=\"\"\n  if [ \"$#\" -ge 3 ]; then\n    shift 2\n    if [ \"${1:-}\" = \"--\" ]; then shift; fi\n    reason=\"$*\"\n  fi\n  [ -z \"$reason\" ] && reason=\"(no reason provided)\"\n\n  case \"$severity\" in\n    CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW) ;;\n    critical|Critical) severity=\"CRITICAL\" ;;\n    high|High) severity=\"HIGH\" ;;\n    medium|Medium) severity=\"MEDIUM\" ;;\n    low|Low) severity=\"LOW\" ;;\n    *) severity=\"HIGH\" ;;\n  esac\n\n  # Idempotent: never overwrite an existing gate (preserve the original reason).\n  if [ -f \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" ]; then\n    log \"gate already active — not overwriting (slug=$slug)\"\n    printf 'BLOCK-CONTROL: a gate is already active (see %s). Not overwriting.\\n' \"$BLOCK_FLAG\"\n    return 0\n  fi\n\n  {\n    printf 'BLOCKED at %s by block-control.sh (raised-by=agent severity=%s slug=%s)\\n' \"$TS\" \"$severity\" \"$slug\"\n    printf '\\n'\n    printf 'REASON / RECOMMENDATION:\\n'\n    printf '%s\\n' \"$reason\"\n    printf '\\n'\n    printf 'TO RESUME (simplest first):\\n'\n    printf '  1. Just reply to the agent with one of: \"approved\" / \"unblock\" / \"run autonomous\" / \"go ahead\" / \"tiep tuc\".\\n'\n    printf '     A UserPromptSubmit hook (block-control.sh check-prompt) auto-clears the gate. No file deletion needed.\\n'\n    printf '  2. Or run:  bash scripts/hooks/block-control.sh clear\\n'\n    printf '  3. Emergency bypass: set env STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS=1 (logged to mistake-log).\\n'\n  } > \"$BLOCK_FLAG\"\n\n  log \"gate RAISED severity=$severity slug=$slug reason_first80=${reason:0:80}\"\n\n  # Telegram push (best-effort; telegram-push.sh no-ops if creds absent / honors DRY_RUN).\n  if [ -r \"$TELEGRAM_HOOK\" ]; then\n    bash \"$TELEGRAM_HOOK\" \"$severity\" \"GATE RAISED [$slug]: ${reason:0:280} -- reply 'approved' or 'unblock' to resume.\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  fi\n\n  printf 'BLOCK-CONTROL: gate RAISED (severity=%s slug=%s). Flag: %s. Telegram pushed (best-effort).\\n' \"$severity\" \"$slug\" \"$BLOCK_FLAG\"\n  return 0\n}\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# clear [actor] [reason...]\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncmd_clear() {\n  local actor reason had_flag expiry\n  actor=\"${1:-manual}\"\n  if [ \"$#\" -ge 1 ]; then shift; fi\n  reason=\"$*\"\n  [ -z \"$reason\" ] && reason=\"(no reason)\"\n\n  had_flag=\"no\"\n  [ -f \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" ] && had_flag=\"yes\"\n\n  # Remove the block flag.\n  rm -f \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  # Remove the stale severity cache — escalation-engine reads it on UserPromptSubmit\n  # and would instantly re-raise. severity-classifier regenerates it cleanly on Stop.\n  rm -f \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  # Remove false-positive auto-reboot markers (the S316 incident root cause class).\n  rm -f \"$MEM_DIR\"/.auto-reboot-PRE-BLOCKED-* 2>/dev/null || true\n\n  # Grace window: escalation-engine respects this and won't instantly re-raise,\n  # giving the agent room to fix the root cause.\n  expiry=$(( NOW_EPOCH + GRACE_SECONDS ))\n  {\n    printf 'expiry_epoch=%s\\n' \"$expiry\"\n    printf 'cleared_at=%s\\n' \"$TS\"\n    printf 'cleared_by=%s\\n' \"$actor\"\n    printf 'reason=%s\\n' \"$reason\"\n  } > \"$GRACE_FILE\"\n\n  log \"gate CLEARED actor=$actor had_flag=$had_flag grace_until_epoch=$expiry reason_first80=${reason:0:80}\"\n  printf 'BLOCK-CONTROL: gate CLEARED (was_blocked=%s by=%s). Grace %ss — escalation-engine auto-raise suppressed until then. Autonomous mode resumed.\\n' \"$had_flag\" \"$actor\" \"$GRACE_SECONDS\"\n  return 0\n}\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# status\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncmd_status() {\n  local exp\n  if [ -f \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" ]; then\n    printf 'BLOCK-CONTROL STATUS: BLOCKED\\n'\n    printf -- '--- flag content ---\\n'\n    cat \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" 2>/dev/null || true\n    printf -- '--- end flag content ---\\n'\n  else\n    printf 'BLOCK-CONTROL STATUS: CLEAR\\n'\n    if [ -f \"$GRACE_FILE\" ]; then\n      exp=\"$(grep '^expiry_epoch=' \"$GRACE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/^expiry_epoch=//' || echo 0)\"\n      case \"$exp\" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exp=0 ;; esac\n      if [ \"$exp\" -gt \"$NOW_EPOCH\" ]; then\n        printf 'grace: ACTIVE, %ss remaining (escalation-engine auto-raise suppressed)\\n' \"$(( exp - NOW_EPOCH ))\"\n      else\n        printf 'grace: expired\\n'\n      fi\n    else\n      printf 'grace: none\\n'\n    fi\n  fi\n  return 0\n}\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# check-prompt  (UserPromptSubmit hook entry)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncmd_check_prompt() {\n  # No gate active -> nothing to do.\n  [ -f \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" ] || exit 0\n\n  local payload user_prompt prompt_lower approval_re matched\n  payload=\"$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n  user_prompt=\"$(printf '%s' \"$payload\" | node -e \"\nlet s=''; process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);\nprocess.stdin.on('end',()=>{ try { console.log(JSON.parse(s).prompt || JSON.parse(s).user_message || ''); } catch { console.log(''); } });\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"\")\"\n\n  # Fallback: env var (non-standard invocation paths / manual testing).\n  [ -z \"$user_prompt\" ] && user_prompt=\"${CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT:-}\"\n  [ -z \"$user_prompt\" ] && exit 0\n\n  prompt_lower=\"$(printf '%s' \"$user_prompt\" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')\"\n\n  # Negation guard — if the prompt explicitly says NOT to unblock, leave the gate.\n  if printf '%s' \"$prompt_lower\" | grep -qE \"(do not|don'?t|never|not approv|not unblock|keep block|stay block|chua approv|khong unblock)\" 2>/dev/null; then\n    log \"check-prompt: negation detected — gate left active\"\n    exit 0\n  fi\n\n  # Approval keywords (EN + VI). Bounded by non-letter / line-edge to limit false hits.\n  approval_re='(^|[^a-z])(approved?|unblock|un-block|run autonomous|resume autonomous|continue autonomous|go ahead|proceed|green light|greenlight|tiep tuc|dong y|chap nhan|mo khoa|go block)([^a-z]|$)'\n\n  if printf '%s' \"$prompt_lower\" | grep -qE \"$approval_re\" 2>/dev/null; then\n    matched=\"$(printf '%s' \"$prompt_lower\" | grep -oE \"$approval_re\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/^[^a-z]*//; s/[^a-z]*$//' || echo \"approval\")\"\n    cmd_clear \"human-prompt\" \"matched approval keyword: $matched\" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\n    log \"check-prompt: AUTO-CLEARED via keyword '$matched'\"\n    printf 'BLOCK-CONTROL: human approval keyword detected (\"%s\") — autonomous gate AUTO-CLEARED. The agent may resume work this turn. (block-control.sh check-prompt)\\n' \"$matched\"\n    exit 0\n  fi\n\n  # Gate active but no approval keyword — leave it; the enforcer keeps blocking and\n  # injects its own \"still blocked\" context.\n  log \"check-prompt: gate active, no approval keyword — left active\"\n  exit 0\n}\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# dispatch\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ncase \"$SUBCMD\" in\n  raise)\n    shift 2>/dev/null || true\n    cmd_raise \"$@\"\n    ;;\n  clear)\n    shift 2>/dev/null || true\n    cmd_clear \"$@\"\n    ;;\n  status)\n    cmd_status\n    ;;\n  check-prompt)\n    cmd_check_prompt\n    ;;\n  *)\n    printf 'block-control.sh — unknown subcommand: %s\\n' \"$SUBCMD\" >&2\n    printf 'usage: block-control.sh {raise <severity> <slug> -- <reason> | clear [actor] [reason] | status | check-prompt}\\n' >&2\n    ;;\nesac\n\nexit 0\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":131,"cache_read_input_tokens":193659,"output_tokens":5102,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":131,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":5102,"cache_read_input_tokens":193659,"cache_creation_input_tokens":131,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":131},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011Cb274qmRkvwpN3HQrGHAh","type":"assistant","uuid":"d93283d5-62a2-4dc6-a70f-1175a67f0659","timestamp":"2026-05-14T07:57:36.500Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"0feebcd1-f1e5-45b7-b72e-a3e4389b0ef7","version":"2.1.138","gitBranch":"main"}

Override: STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS=1 env bypasses block (and logs to mistake-log).","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# autonomous-block-enforcer.sh — Phase C of unified severity/escalation system (proposal §2 Layer 4)\n#\n# When `agent-workspace/memory/.autonomous-BLOCKED` flag exists:\n#   - UserPromptSubmit cadence ($1=UserPromptSubmit): inject loud BLOCKED context via stdout\n#   - PreToolUse cadence ($1=PreToolUse): exit RC=2 (block) for Edit/Write/Bash/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit\n#     (Read/Glob/Grep stay allowed for diagnostic)\n#\n# Override: STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS=1 env bypasses block (and logs to mistake-log).\n#\n# Bash + POSIX only per L-S11-1. Default RC=0 (allow); RC=2 (block) only when guarded tool + flag present.\n# SPAWN-CONTEXT: bash-c (companion firing-test required per L-S247-1 / firing-test-spawn-context-lint.sh)\n\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nEVENT=\"${1:-${HOOK_EVENT:-UserPromptSubmit}}\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nMEM_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nBLOCK_FLAG=\"$MEM_DIR/.autonomous-BLOCKED\"\nLOG=\"$MEM_DIR/.autonomous-block-enforcer.log\"\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds)\"\n\nmkdir -p \"$MEM_DIR\"\n\n# No flag → allow silently\n[ -f \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" ] || exit 0\n\n# Override env → allow + log warning\nif [ \"${STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS:-0}\" = \"1\" ]; then\n  printf '[%s] autonomous-block-enforcer: BYPASSED via STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS=1 (event=%s)\\n' \"$TS\" \"$EVENT\" >> \"$LOG\"\n  exit 0\nfi\n\n# Read flag content (truncated to 40 lines for context budget)\nFLAG_CONTENT=$(head -40 \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" 2>/dev/null || echo \"(empty)\")\n\ncase \"$EVENT\" in\n  UserPromptSubmit)\n    # Output via stdout becomes additionalContext for the LLM\n    {\n      printf 'AUTONOMOUS-BLOCKED active. Flag location: %s\\n\\n' \"$BLOCK_FLAG\"\n      printf '--- Flag content (verbatim) ---\\n'\n      printf '%s\\n' \"$FLAG_CONTENT\"\n      printf -- '--- End flag content ---\\n\\n'\n      printf 'Agent instructions this turn:\\n'\n      printf '  1. DO NOT proceed with any new work (Edit/Write/Bash tools are blocked by PreToolUse hook).\\n'\n      printf '  2. Respond to user with one-paragraph status of the blocking artifacts (Read/Glob/Grep allowed for diagnostic).\\n'\n      printf '  3. Wait for human to resolve + delete the flag file.\\n'\n      printf '  4. Emergency only: user can set STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS=1 env to bypass (logged to mistake-log).\\n'\n    }\n    printf '[%s] autonomous-block-enforcer: UserPromptSubmit injection emitted\\n' \"$TS\" >> \"$LOG\"\n    exit 0\n    ;;\n  PreToolUse)\n    # Read tool name from Claude Code's env: CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME (newer) or stdin JSON.\n    # Fallback: assume guarded unless explicitly allowed via env.\n    TOOL_NAME=\"${CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME:-}\"\n    if [ -z \"$TOOL_NAME\" ] && [ ! -t 0 ]; then\n      # Try parsing stdin JSON for tool_name\n      STDIN_JSON=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)\n      TOOL_NAME=$(printf '%s' \"$STDIN_JSON\" | grep -o '\"tool_name\":\"[^\"]*\"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*:\"\\([^\"]*\\)\"/\\1/' || echo \"\")\n    fi\n    case \"$TOOL_NAME\" in\n      Read|Glob|Grep|\"\")\n        # Read-only or unknown — allow (default safe)\n        exit 0\n        ;;\n      Edit|Write|Bash|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Agent)\n        # Block via RC=2 with stderr message\n        echo \"AUTONOMOUS-BLOCKED: tool=$TOOL_NAME denied. Flag at $BLOCK_FLAG. See flag content for resolution path. Emergency override: STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS=1 env.\" >&2\n        printf '[%s] autonomous-block-enforcer: PreToolUse BLOCKED tool=%s\\n' \"$TS\" \"$TOOL_NAME\" >> \"$LOG\"\n        exit 2\n        ;;\n      *)\n        # Unknown guarded tool — allow but log\n        printf '[%s] autonomous-block-enforcer: PreToolUse unknown tool=%s allowed by default\\n' \"$TS\" \"$TOOL_NAME\" >> \"$LOG\"\n        exit 0\n        ;;\n    esac\n    ;;\n  *)\n    exit 0\n    ;;\nesac\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":3,"oldLines":10,"newStart":3,"newLines":15,"lines":[" #"," # When `agent-workspace/memory/.autonomous-BLOCKED` flag exists:"," #   - UserPromptSubmit cadence ($1=UserPromptSubmit): inject loud BLOCKED context via stdout","-#   - PreToolUse cadence ($1=PreToolUse): exit RC=2 (block) for Edit/Write/Bash/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit","+#   - PreToolUse cadence ($1=PreToolUse): exit RC=2 (block) for Edit/Write/Bash/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit/Agent"," #     (Read/Glob/Grep stay allowed for diagnostic)","+#   - ESCAPE HATCH: a Bash call that invokes `block-control.sh` is ALWAYS allowed, even","+#     while blocked — that script's only job is gate management (status/clear/raise), so","+#     the agent/human can clear the gate without a manual file delete (the S316 deadlock)."," #","-# Override: STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS=1 env bypasses block (and logs to mistake-log).","+# Clearing the gate: the normal path is `block-control.sh check-prompt` (UserPromptSubmit","+# hook) auto-clearing when the human replies \"approved\" / \"unblock\" / etc. — see","+# block-control.sh. esac\n  if [ \"$GRACE_EXP\" -gt \"$GRACE_NOW\" ]; then\n    GRACE_ACTIVE=1\n  else\n    rm -f \"$GRACE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  fi\nfi\n\n# Per-event idempotency markers (hour-bucket to avoid stale-marker bug — L-S108-1)","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# escalation-engine.sh — Phase B of unified severity/escalation system (proposal §2 Layer 3)\n#\n# Reads agent-workspace/memory/.severity-state.tsv (produced by severity-classifier.sh)\n# and acts per severity row:\n#   CRITICAL → write .autonomous-BLOCKED flag + URGENT entry + Telegram push\n#   HIGH     → append URGENT + UserPromptSubmit additionalContext for AskUserQuestion + Telegram push\n#   MEDIUM   → append weekly digest entry\n#   LOW      → log only\n#\n# Fires on three cadences: Stop + SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit.\n# Argument $1 = event name (Stop / SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit). Defaults to \"Stop\".\n#\n# Bash + POSIX only per L-S11-1. RC=0 always (best-effort).\n# UserPromptSubmit cadence: outputs JSON additionalContext via stdout when HIGH items demand AskUserQuestion.\n\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nEVENT=\"${1:-${HOOK_EVENT:-Stop}}\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nMEM_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"\nSTATE_FILE=\"$MEM_DIR/.severity-state.tsv\"\nURGENT=\"$PROJECT_DIR/human-workspace/notifications/urgent.md\"\nBLOCK_FLAG=\"$MEM_DIR/.autonomous-BLOCKED\"\nLOG=\"$MEM_DIR/.escalation-engine.log\"\nTELEGRAM_HOOK=\"$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hooks/telegram-push.sh\"\n\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds)\"\nBUCKET=\"$(date +%Y%m%d-%H 2>/dev/null)\"\n[ -z \"$BUCKET\" ] && BUCKET=\"unbucketed-$$\"\n\nmkdir -p \"$MEM_DIR\" \"$(dirname \"$URGENT\")\"\n\n# Skip if state file absent (classifier hasn't run yet)\n[ -f \"$STATE_FILE\" ] || exit 0\n\n# Per-event idempotency markers (hour-bucket to avoid stale-marker bug — L-S108-1)\nMARKER=\"$MEM_DIR/.escalation-fired-${EVENT}-${BUCKET}\"\n\n# Cleanup stale markers\nfor old in \"$MEM_DIR\"/.escalation-fired-*; do\n  [ -f \"$old\" ] || continue\n  case \"$old\" in\n    *\".escalation-fired-${EVENT}-${BUCKET}\") ;;\n    *\".escalation-fired-${EVENT}-\"*) rm -f \"$old\" 2>/dev/null ;;\n  esac\ndone\n\n# === Collect rows by severity (strip header/comment lines) ===\nCRIT_ROWS=$(grep \"^CRITICAL\"$'\\t' \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\nHIGH_ROWS=$(grep \"^HIGH\"$'\\t' \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\nMED_ROWS=$(grep \"^MEDIUM\"$'\\t' \"$STATE_FILE\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n\nCRIT_N=$([ -z \"$CRIT_ROWS\" ] && echo 0 || printf '%s\\n' \"$CRIT_ROWS\" | grep -c .)\nHIGH_N=$([ -z \"$HIGH_ROWS\" ] && echo 0 || printf '%s\\n' \"$HIGH_ROWS\" | grep -c .)\nMED_N=$([ -z \"$MED_ROWS\" ] && echo 0 || printf '%s\\n' \"$MED_ROWS\" | grep -c .)\n\n# HIGH rows that are genuine Q&A bundles (severity-classifier Layer 2). Only these\n# warrant the \"MUST fire AskUserQuestion\" demand — L-S310-1 rule 3 is explicitly\n# scoped to a \"SCOPE+CHARTER bundle pending >6h\". HIGH rows from Layer 5\n# (notification files) escalate to urgent.md but are NOT AskUserQuestion-eligible:\n# notifications are agent->human informational pushes, not blocked decisions.\n# Without this split, a backlog of HIGH notifications falsely demands a (possibly\n# huge) AskUserQuestion every UserPromptSubmit.\nHIGH_QA_ROWS=$(printf '%s\\n' \"$HIGH_ROWS\" | grep 'q-and-a/pending/' 2>/dev/null || true)\nHIGH_QA_N=$([ -z \"$HIGH_QA_ROWS\" ] && echo 0 || printf '%s\\n' \"$HIGH_QA_ROWS\" | grep -c .)\n\n# === CRITICAL handling — write block flag (always; idempotent via flag presence check) ===\nif [ \"$CRIT_N\" -gt 0 ]; then\n  if [ ! -f \"$BLOCK_FLAG\" ]; then\n    {\n      printf 'BLOCKED at %s by escalation-engine.sh (event=%s)\\n' \"$TS\" \"$EVENT\"\n      printf 'CRITICAL_COUNT=%s\\n' \"$CRIT_N\"\n      printf 'Affected artifacts:\\n'\n      printf '%s\\n' \"$CRIT_ROWS\" | awk -F'\\t' '{printf \"  - %s (age=%sh, next=%s)\\n\", $2, $3, $4}'\n      printf '\\nResolution required:\\n'\n      printf '  1. Review each affected artifact above\\n'\n      printf '  2. Resolve OR explicitly downgrade severity\\n'\n      printf '  3. Delete this flag file: rm \"%s\"\\n' \"$BLOCK_FLAG\"\n      printf '  4. Submit any prompt to resume autonomous mode\\n'\n      printf '\\nEmergency override: set env STOCKFORGE_FORCE_AUTONOMOUS=1 (will log warning to mistake-log)\\n'\n    } > \"$BLOCK_FLAG\"\n    echo \"escalation-engine: $CRIT_N CRITICAL items detected; .autonomous-BLOCKED flag written\" >&2\n  fi\nfi\n\n# === Idempotency: most actions per hour-bucket; CRITICAL flag always re-checked ===\nHAS_HIGH_DELTA=0\nif [ -f \"$MARKER\" ]; then\n  # Skip Stop/SessionStart re-emission; UserPromptSubmit still injects context for LLM\n  case \"$EVENT\" in\n    UserPromptSubmit) ;;  # always emit injection\n    *) [ \"$CRIT_N\" -eq 0 ] && exit 0 ;;\n  esac\nelse\n  HAS_HIGH_DELTA=1\nfi\n\n# === HIGH handling — urgent.md append + UserPromptSubmit additionalContext ===\nif [ \"$HIGH_N\" -gt 0 ] && [ \"$HAS_HIGH_DELTA\" -eq 1 ]; then\n  {\n    printf '\\n## ESCALATION — %s — %d HIGH-severity items (event=%s)\\n\\n' \"$TS\" \"$HIGH_N\" \"$EVENT\"\n    printf 'Fired by: scripts/hooks/escalation-engine.sh\\n'\n    if [ \"$HIGH_QA_N\" -gt 0 ]; then\n      printf 'Action required from agent: fire AskUserQuestion for the %d Q&A bundle(s) below.\\n' \"$HIGH_QA_N\"\n      printf 'Remaining HIGH rows are notification escalations — informational, no AskUserQuestion.\\n\\n'\n    else\n      printf 'Action: review the HIGH-severity notification(s) below. These are informational\\n'\n      printf 'escalations (no pending Q&A bundle) — no AskUserQuestion required.\\n\\n'\n    fi\n    printf '%s\\n' \"$HIGH_ROWS\" | awk -F'\\t' '{printf \"- `%s` (age=%sh, action=%s)\\n\", $2, $3, $4}'\n    if [ \"$HIGH_QA_N\" -gt 0 ]; then\n      printf '\\nPer L-S310-1 rule 3: agent MUST fire AskUserQuestion when SCOPE+CHARTER bundle pending >6h with no user signal.\\n\\n'\n    else\n      printf '\\n'\n    fi\n    printf -- '---\\n'\n  } >> \"$URGENT\"\nfi\n\n# === MEDIUM handling — weekly digest (week-bucket) ===\nif [ \"$MED_N\" -gt 0 ]; then\n  WEEK=$(date +%G-W%V 2>/dev/null || echo \"unbucketed\")\n  DIGEST=\"$PROJECT_DIR/human-workspace/notifications/digest-${WEEK}.md\"\n  WEEK_MARKER=\"$MEM_DIR/.escalation-digest-fired-${WEEK}\"\n  if [ ! -f \"$WEEK_MARKER\" ]; then\n    {\n      printf '# Weekly MEDIUM-severity digest — %s\\n\\n' \"$WEEK\"\n      printf 'Generated %s by escalation-engine.sh\\n\\n' \"$TS\"\n      printf '%s\\n' \"$MED_ROWS\" | awk -F'\\t' '{printf \"- %s (age=%sh, action=%s)\\n\", $2, $3, $4}'\n    } > \"$DIGEST\"\n    echo \"fired\" > \"$WEEK_MARKER\"\n  fi\nfi\n\n# === UserPromptSubmit cadence: inject additionalContext via JSON stdout ===\n# Claude Code reads UserPromptSubmit hook stdout as additionalContext. We emit a brief\n# system-reminder when CRITICAL or HIGH+age>6h items exist, instructing LLM to act.\nif [ \"$EVENT\" = \"UserPromptSubmit\" ]; then\n  if [ \"$CRIT_N\" -gt 0 ]; then\n    printf 'SEVERITY-ESCALATION CRITICAL: %d item(s) require human resolution. .autonomous-BLOCKED flag is ACTIVE. Agent MUST fire AskUserQuestion this turn for the pending bundles before resuming other work. ERRORS+=(\"$1\"); }\nnote_pass() { PASS=$((PASS+1)); }\n\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\" && pwd)\"\nHOOK=\"$SCRIPT_DIR/block-control.sh\"\n[ -r \"$HOOK\" ] || { echo \"FAIL: hook not readable at $HOOK\"; exit 1; }\n\nTMP=\"$(mktemp -d -t block-control-test-XXXXXX 2>/dev/null || mktemp -d)\"\ntrap 'rm -rf \"$TMP\"' EXIT\n\nMEM=\"\"\n\nsetup_tmp() {\n  rm -rf \"$TMP\"/*\n  mkdir -p \"$TMP/agent-workspace/memory\"\n  MEM=\"$TMP/agent-workspace/memory\"\n}\n\nrun_bc() {\n  CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TMP\" bash \"$HOOK\" \"$@\"\n}\n\n# === TC1: status, no flag → CLEAR ===\nsetup_tmp\nOUT=$(run_bc status 2>/dev/null)\nif echo \"$OUT\" | grep -q \"CLEAR\"; then note_pass; else note_fail \"TC1: status no-flag expected CLEAR, got: ${OUT:0:80}\"; fi\n\n# === TC2: raise → flag written with content ===\nsetup_tmp\nrun_bc raise CRITICAL test-slug -- test reason text >/dev/null 2>&1\nRC=$?\nif [ \"$RC\" -eq 0 ] && [ -f \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" ] \\\n   && grep -q \"severity=CRITICAL\" \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" \\\n   && grep -q \"slug=test-slug\" \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" \\\n   && grep -q \"test reason text\" \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\"; then\n  note_pass\nelse\n  note_fail \"TC2: raise did not write a well-formed flag (RC=$RC)\"\nfi\n\n# === TC3: status, flag present → BLOCKED + content ===\nOUT=$(run_bc status 2>/dev/null)\nif echo \"$OUT\" | grep -q \"BLOCKED\" && echo \"$OUT\" | grep -q \"test reason text\"; then\n  note_pass\nelse\n  note_fail \"TC3: status with flag expected BLOCKED + content, got: ${OUT:0:80}\"\nfi\n\n# === TC4: raise again → idempotent (flag not overwritten) ===\nrun_bc raise HIGH other-slug -- different reason >/dev/null 2>&1\nif grep -q \"slug=test-slug\" \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" && ! grep -q \"slug=other-slug\" \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\"; then\n  note_pass\nelse\n  note_fail \"TC4: second raise overwrote the original flag\"\nfi\n\n# === TC5: clear → flag + state.tsv gone, .block-grace written with future expiry ===\nsetup_tmp\nrun_bc raise HIGH s -- r >/dev/null 2>&1\nprintf 'CRITICAL\\tx\\t0\\tBLOCK\\tts\\n' > \"$MEM/.severity-state.tsv\"\nrun_bc clear test-actor cleared for test >/dev/null 2>&1\nif [ ! -f \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" ] && [ ! -f \"$MEM/.severity-state.tsv\" ] && [ -f \"$MEM/.block-grace\" ]; esac\n  if [ \"$GEXP\" -gt \"$GNOW\" ]; then note_pass; else note_fail \"TC5: .block-grace expiry not in the future\"; fi\nelse\n  note_fail \"TC5: clear did not remove flag/state.tsv or write .block-grace\"\nfi\n\n# === TC6: check-prompt \"approved\" + flag → cleared + AUTO-CLEARED stdout ===\nsetup_tmp\nrun_bc raise HIGH s -- r >/dev/null 2>&1\nOUT=$(echo '{\"prompt\":\"ok approved, go ahead\"}' | run_bc check-prompt 2>/dev/null)\nif [ ! -f \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" ] && echo \"$OUT\" | grep -q \"AUTO-CLEARED\"; then\n  note_pass\nelse\n  note_fail \"TC6: check-prompt 'approved' did not clear gate / no AUTO-CLEARED stdout\"\nfi\n\n# === TC7: check-prompt non-approval + flag → flag REMAINS ===\nsetup_tmp\nrun_bc raise HIGH s -- r >/dev/null 2>&1\necho '{\"prompt\":\"what is the current status of the build?\"}' | run_bc check-prompt >/dev/null 2>&1\nif [ -f \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" ]; then note_pass; else note_fail \"TC7: non-approval prompt wrongly cleared the gate\"; fi\n\n# === TC8: check-prompt, no flag → silent RC=0 ===\nsetup_tmp\nOUT=$(run_bc check-prompt </dev/null 2>/dev/null)\nRC=$?\nif [ \"$RC\" -eq 0 ] && [ -z \"$OUT\" ]; then note_pass; else note_fail \"TC8: check-prompt no-flag expected silent RC=0, got RC=$RC out=${OUT:0:60}\"; fi\n\n# === TC9: check-prompt VN \"tiep tuc\" + flag → cleared ===\nsetup_tmp\nrun_bc raise HIGH s -- r >/dev/null 2>&1\necho '{\"prompt\":\"tiep tuc chay autonomous di\"}' | run_bc check-prompt >/dev/null 2>&1\nif [ ! -f \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" ]; then note_pass; else note_fail \"TC9: VN keyword 'tiep tuc' did not clear the gate\"; fi\n\n# === TC10: check-prompt negation + flag → flag REMAINS ===\nsetup_tmp\nrun_bc raise HIGH s -- r >/dev/null 2>&1\necho '{\"prompt\":\"do not unblock yet, still reviewing\"}' | run_bc check-prompt >/dev/null 2>&1\nif [ -f \"$MEM/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" ]; then note_pass; else note_fail \"TC10: negation 'do not unblock' wrongly cleared the gate\"; fi\n\n# === TC11: clear removes .auto-reboot-PRE-BLOCKED-* markers ===\nsetup_tmp\nrun_bc raise HIGH s -- r >/dev/null 2>&1\nprintf 'stale marker\\n' > \"$MEM/.auto-reboot-PRE-BLOCKED-stale-checkpoint\"\nrun_bc clear >/dev/null 2>&1\nif [ ! -f \"$MEM/.auto-reboot-PRE-BLOCKED-stale-checkpoint\" ]; then note_pass; else note_fail \"TC11: clear did not remove .auto-reboot-PRE-BLOCKED-* marker\"; fi\n\n# Summary\nTOTAL=$((PASS+FAIL))\necho \"block-control-fire-test: $PASS/$TOTAL PASS\"\n[ \"$FAIL\" -gt 0 ] && { for e in \"${ERRORS[@]}\"; firing-test must exercise both)\n\nset -uo pipefail\n\nPASS=0\nFAIL=0\nERRORS=()\nnote_fail() { FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); ERRORS+=(\"$1\"); }\nnote_pass() { PASS=$((PASS+1)); }\n\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\" && pwd)\"\nHOOK=\"$SCRIPT_DIR/autonomous-block-enforcer.sh\"\n[ -r \"$HOOK\" ] || { echo \"FAIL: hook not readable at $HOOK\"; exit 1; }\n\nTMP=\"$(mktemp -d -t block-enforcer-test-XXXXXX 2>/dev/null || mktemp -d)\"\ntrap 'rm -rf \"$TMP\"' EXIT\n\nsetup_tmp() {\n  rm -rf \"$TMP\"/*\n  mkdir -p \"$TMP/agent-workspace/memory\"\n}\n\nset_flag() {\n  cat > \"$TMP/agent-workspace/memory/.autonomous-BLOCKED\" <<EOF\nBLOCKED test\nCRITICAL_COUNT=1\nEOF\n}\n\nrun_hook() {\n  local event=\"$1\" tool=\"${2:-}\"\n  CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TMP\" CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME=\"$tool\" bash \"$HOOK\" \"$event\"\n  return $?\n}\n\n# === TC1: no flag → RC=0 silent ===\nsetup_tmp\nrun_hook UserPromptSubmit >/dev/null 2>&1\nRC=$?\n[ \"$RC\" -eq 0 ] && note_pass || note_fail \"TC1 UserPromptSubmit: expected RC=0, got $RC\"\n\nrun_hook PreToolUse Edit >/dev/null 2>&1\nRC=$?\n[ \"$RC\" -eq 0 ] && note_pass || note_fail \"TC1 PreToolUse Edit no-flag: expected RC=0, got $RC\"\n\n# === TC2: flag + UserPromptSubmit → RC=0 + stdout has BLOCKED ===\nsetup_tmp\nset_flag\nOUT=$(run_hook UserPromptSubmit 2>/dev/null)\nRC=$?\nif [ \"$RC\" -eq 0 ] && echo \"$OUT\" | grep -q \"AUTONOMOUS-BLOCKED\"; then\n  note_pass\nelse\n  note_fail \"TC3: expected RC=2 + AUTONOMOUS-BLOCKED in stderr; got RC=$RC stderr_first80=${ERR:0:80}\"\nfi\n\n# Additional guarded tools\nfor guarded_tool in Write Bash MultiEdit; {"parentUuid":"ecb9fad8-85fb-4e02-8ddd-2370f3b5eec6","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_012PMDYaR83cwgLgpiMbZ3oZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01FVfVr3CjUxKPXm6RF4ZGfZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\.claude\\commands\\block.md","content":"# /block — Human-Gate Control (status / clear / raise)\n\n> Created 2026-05-14 (S317 post-incident) per user request: make block/unblock \"as simple\n> as possible, deterministic hook/script the agent can toggle easily — like /autonomous\".\n> Thin wrapper over `scripts/hooks/block-control.sh` — the single interface for the\n> \"agent hits a block / q&a / confirm / decision → notify human → human approves → resume\" loop.\n\n## The loop this supports\n\n1. Agent hits something needing a human (block / Q&A / confirm / decision) →\n   runs `block-control.sh raise` → writes the `.autonomous-BLOCKED` flag + **Telegram push**.\n2. `autonomous-block-enforcer.sh` (PreToolUse) then blocks Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Agent + most\n   Bash until the gate clears. Read/Glob/Grep + `block-control.sh` itself stay allowed.\n3. Human reads the Telegram, sees the reason + recommendations.\n4. Human **just replies** `approved` / `unblock` / `run autonomous` / `go ahead` / `tiep tuc` —\n   `block-control.sh check-prompt` (UserPromptSubmit hook) auto-clears the gate. No file ops.\n5. `clear` also writes a 30-min `.block-grace` marker so `escalation-engine.sh` won't instantly\n   re-raise the same CRITICAL — giving the agent room to fix the root cause.\n\n## Usage\n\n| Form | Effect |\n|---|---|\n| `/block` | Same as `/block status` |\n| `/block status` | Report gate state — BLOCKED (+ flag content) or CLEAR (+ grace remaining) |\n| `/block clear` | Clear the gate now (flag + stale `.severity-state.tsv` + `.auto-reboot-PRE-BLOCKED-*` markers; writes `.block-grace`) |\n| `/block raise <severity> <slug> -- <reason / recommendation>` | Manually raise a gate + Telegram push. `<severity>` = CRITICAL\\|HIGH\\|MEDIUM\\|LOW |\n\n## Agent execution instructions\n\nThis command is a thin pass-through. For ALL forms, run the script and report its stdout verbatim (1-3 lines):\n\n- `/block` or `/block status` → `bash scripts/hooks/block-control.sh status`\n- `/block clear` → `bash scripts/hooks/block-control.sh clear user-via-/block`\n- `/block raise <sev> <slug> -- <reason>` → `bash scripts/hooks/block-control.sh raise <sev> <slug> -- <reason>`\n\n`block-control.sh` is exempt from the `autonomous-block-enforcer.sh` Bash block (escape hatch),\nso `/block status` and `/block clear` work **even while the gate is active**.\n\n## How the agent should RAISE a gate (not via this command)\n\nWhen the agent itself hits a block/Q&A/confirm/decision mid-task, it does NOT need this command —\nit runs the script directly:\n\n```bash\nbash scripts/hooks/block-control.sh raise HIGH <short-slug> -- <one-paragraph reason + the recommendation the human should approve>\n```\n\nThen end the turn with a one-paragraph status. The human resumes by replying with an approval keyword.\n\n## Relationship to /autonomous\n\n- `/autonomous on|off` — toggles whether the autonomous loop runs at all (continue-injector + budget-watchdog).\n- `/block` — a **pause on top of** the autonomous loop: \"stop and wait for a human decision\", then resume.\n\nThey are independent. A gate raised by `/block` (or by `block-control.sh raise`, or auto-raised by\n`escalation-engine.sh` on a CRITICAL) pauses work regardless of `/autonomous` state; clearing it\nresumes at whatever the `/autonomous` state is.\n\n## Hard rules\n\n- This command bypasses NO other safety gate (`destructive-command-guard.sh`, drift-signals,\n  charter immutability, write-vs-edit-guard, etc. all still active).\n- `clear` is decisive: it removes the flag + the stale severity cache + false-positive\n  auto-reboot markers, and opens a grace window. It does NOT resolve the underlying root cause —\n  if a real CRITICAL artifact persists past the 30-min grace, `escalation-engine.sh` re-raises.\n- Approval-keyword auto-clear has a negation guard (\"do not unblock\", \"keep blocked\", etc. are\n  ignored) — but it is still keyword-based; when in doubt, the human can run `/block clear` explicitly.\n- Idempotent: `raise` will not overwrite an already-active gate; `clear` on an already-clear gate\n  is a harmless no-op that just refreshes the grace window.\n\n## Companion artifacts\n\n- Script: `scripts/hooks/block-control.sh` (raise / clear / status / check-prompt)\n- Enforcer: `scripts/hooks/autonomous-block-enforcer.sh` (PreToolUse gate + escape hatch)\n- Auto-raiser: `scripts/hooks/escalation-engine.sh` (CRITICAL → raise; respects `.block-grace`)\n- Firing-test: `scripts/hooks/firing-tests/block-control-fire-test.sh`\n- Wired: `.claude/settings.json` — `block-control.sh check-prompt` is first in the UserPromptSubmit chain.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":749,"cache_read_input_tokens":247298,"output_tokens":1946,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":749,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1946,"cache_read_input_tokens":247298,"cache_creation_input_tokens":749,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":749},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011Cb28gEBu5h1LnZSRJSeNM","type":"assistant","uuid":"765b0598-8b3b-43ae-9704-c5ec8522f01b","timestamp":"2026-05-14T08:18:19.039Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"0feebcd1-f1e5-45b7-b72e-a3e4389b0ef7","version":"2.1.138","gitBranch":"main"}
